text:
frank: Heads-up — planning a base-image refresh (runtime-canary) tomorrow 01:00 UTC. Need RBAC changes for the image-builder service account and a KMS signer rotation. Also want to confirm audit export paths and vuln triage steps. @olivia can you confirm the security checklist?

olivia: :eyes: pinging infra + sec. what's the exact scope for the RBAC change and key rotation window?

frank: Scope: remove cluster-admin from image-builder SA, grant only iam.workloadIdentityUser + a namespaced role to write to artifact buckets. KMS plan: create new cosign signer key in staging KMS, test signing workflow, then promote to prod. Audit: ensure both iam.setIamPolicy and cosign attestations are exported. Any obvious blockers?

nate: For the RBAC switch we should use a temporary binding pattern so CI doesn't break. Proposed flow:
- preflight: add temp binding with TTL=2h
- run canary builds and sign
- verify images in registry and attestations
- remove temp binding
I can put this into a terraform apply script and gate it behind a manual approval.

olivia: Yes to temp binding. Also please add an access-review entry and notify the audit team. For KMS, use label "sig-base-v2" on the new key and ensure key rotation is auditable.

maria: Heads-up about runtime side effects: trimming layers will change image digests and might invalidate runtime caches. We should add cache invalidation to the playbook. Suggested snippet:
```
kubectl delete pod -l app=inference-runtime --namespace=prod
# then run cache invalidation job
invalidate-cache --model all
```
That avoids serving stale model code.

frank: Good point. Also vuln triage: base image upgrade must include patched openssl (CVE-2024-xxxx). Build pipeline should run trivy + snyk. If any HIGH results, abort and triage before proceeding.

tara: From product: can apps tolerate a brief 5-10m window of cold-starts after invalidation? We need to rope that into the release notes.

sre-bot: Deploy bot: scheduled job created for 2025-01-18T01:00:00Z. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/base-image-refresh (steps + rollback).

olivia: Two operational asks before we go green:
1) Export IAM setIamPolicy events to BigQuery table `sec_audit.bindings` (so auditors can see RBAC changes)
2) When rotating KMS signer: do NOT delete the old key until fallback verification completes (30m minimum).

nate: I'm on the terraform patch for the temp binding and the IAM export. Will open a PR in ~20m with the plan + approval gate (link will be posted).

maria: I'll run a staging dry-run build and paste cosign output + trivy report here when done.

frank: Final preflight checklist (copying into runbook):
- [ ] infra PR with temp binding and IAM export
- [ ] create new KMS key in staging and test sign/verify
- [ ] run trivy + snyk, confirm no HIGH findings
- [ ] update playbook with runtime cache invalidation steps
- [ ] post-rollout attestation verification (cosign verify-attestation)
- [ ] notify product and SRE on the window
cc: @olivia @nate @maria

olivia: :thumbsup: Keeping this thread as the single source of truth during the window. If anything fails, escalate to sec-oncall and mark the runbook incident flag.

devsec-bot: Reminder: attach the vulnerability diff to the PR for audit. Use label `security:needs-review`.

frank: Thanks all — will post links to PRs & staging artefacts here. If anyone sees a blocker, call it out early.
